Developer Documentation
=======================

Interested in developing? Welcome aboard! You should do the following:

1. Make an account on https://datatrove.as.arizona.edu
2. Join our `Slack workspace <https://join.slack.com/t/astrotrove/shared_invite/zt-4fgc3msme-31VxfdBs_HYYcMpBJ0_UrQ>`_
3. Read and follow the ``README.md`` file on our 
   `github <https://github.com/astro-trove/trove/>`_ to get set up locally
4. Contact the TROVE team at astrotrove@gmail.com or on Slack to get the values for 
   certain environmental variables you will need in your ``settings_local.py`` file
5. Read the ``CONTRIBUTING.md`` for instructions on getting started, how to contribute, 
   and best practices. 
   
And you're off! 

Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or get stuck at any step in 
setting up your server locally.
